column2: Use this template to compare EMR options. Score each feature 1-5 (1=poor, 5=excellent). Calculate weighted totals to help with decision.

column1: 1. Adjust weights based on your priorities
2. Get demos from at least 3 options before deciding
3. Always check references from other DPC practices
4. Consider switching costs if you might outgrow the system
5. Don't over-buy features you won't use initially
